Per-Unit Migration States (one units/<id>.json file per unit — each migrates independently)
PostToolUse hook fires on every Write
In-Flight Collision Resolution (when /next or /migrate sees a unit = in_progress)
Assume crash or abandoned session → proceed and acquire the unit
Case B — Same developer, same host (fresh heartbeat)
Collision with yourself → show warning, ask if you want to retry from scratch
Block — suggest /sync then pick a different unit; /status shows who is working what
State File Schema (templates/ define the shape; /init copies them into the user repo)
Ordered list of unit IDs — set by /plan, order determines migration sequence
{ primary, confidence, candidates[], detected_at } — written by /analyze
{ ui.framework, api.framework, db.type } — chosen by team during /analyze interview
{ holder, acquired_at, expires_at } — advisory, guards /plan + /scaffold only (10-min TTL)
Bumped by /plan, /next, /verify. schema_version const: bump = fresh /init required.
units/<id>.json (per-unit state · N files, one per migration unit)
Files in the legacy app this unit translates from
Files written into the new scaffold
Unit IDs that must be migrated first (e.g. __auth__, UserService)
{ by (email), host, started_at, last_heartbeat } — bumped every Write
{ at, by, action, notes } — audit trail of all transitions
Multi-Developer Model (coordinate offline — standup / Slack — not via the plugin)
state.json touched only on phase transitions
If > 15 min old → assume crash (Case A)
